adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the onError handler builds `message` via a template literal: ``const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;``. Template literals always produce a (truthy) string, even when `err.data?.code` is undefined, resulting in e.g. `"undefined: ..."`. Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never use the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback, making it dead code and potentially showing an "undefined: ..." prefix.
